name: CSO_CRAWL_EXT_URL_DATA
description: This table stores information related to urls crawled for a crawl config.

columns.name: CSO_CRAWL_EXT_URL_DATA_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: CRAWL_CONFIG_ID
columns.description: This column refers to crawl config for which current url was downloaded.

columns.name: CSO_INDEX_QUEUE_ITEM_ID
columns.description: This column specifies index queue item for which this url was downloaded.

columns.name: FETCH_URL
columns.description: This column specifies url that is downloaded.

columns.name: FETCH_URL_ID
columns.description: This column specifies a unique hash for url string.

columns.name: PARENT_URL_ID
columns.description: This column specifies parent of current url.

columns.name: DEPTH_LEVEL
columns.description: This column specifies depth at which this url was downloaded.

columns.name: CONTENT_CHECKSUM
columns.description: This column specifies checksum for the downloaded url content.

columns.name: MIMETYPE
columns.description: This column specifies mimetype for the current url.

columns.name: DETECTED_DOC_LANGUAGE
columns.description: This column specifies detected language for url content.

columns.name: DOC_LANGUAGE
columns.description: This column specifies language in which article was actually created for url content.

columns.name: DOC_SIZE_K
columns.description: This column specifies size of the downloaded content.

columns.name: CHANGE_FREQUENCY
columns.description: This column specifies frequency at which url content is expected to change.

columns.name: URL_PRIORITY
columns.description: This column specifies url priority for processing.

columns.name: URL_LAST_MODIFIED
columns.description: This column specifies when url content was last modified.

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: This column specifies content id of the article created for the url.

columns.name: RAW_EXTERNAL_ID
columns.description: This column specifies ucm id for the uploaded raw url content.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column specifies processing status of the url.

columns.name: LOCK_UNTIL
columns.description: This column specifies time measured in epoch time until which current url cannot be picked again for processing.

columns.name: NEXT_FETCH_DATE
columns.description: This column specifies time measured by epoch time, when this url can be processed again.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.
